question: The light of the sun takes about ______ minutes to reach the earth.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sun**:-

 
 
• The Sun is 109 times bigger than the Earth and weighs 2×1027 tons.
 
• The core of the Sun has a temperature of about 15 million degrees C.
 
• **Sunlight takes 8 min 16.6 sec to reach Earth.**
 
• The density of the Sun is ¼ of that of the Earth.
 
• In its composition, 71% hydrogen and 26.5% of helium are found.
 
• The Sun is about 150 million km away from the Earth.
 
• The Sun is about 150 million km away from the Earth.
 
• Light travels with tremendous speed of about 3,00,000 kilometres per second. Even at this speed, the Sun rays take about eight minutes to reach the Earth.
 
• The source of energy of the Sun is nuclear fusion, in which small nuclei of hydrogen atom fuse into a helium atom.
